svg.aria-label: GameState: Menu > RoundAnnounce > RoundActive. Every system is gated on it. Gameplay systems: Player, boss phases, collision, powerups. Feedback systems: Particles, screen shake, HUD. Audio: Synthesized. Driven by SoundEvent. Render: Shapes + bloom, then the CRT WGSL post-process at a quality tier per platform. Output: A native window or a browser canvas
